newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Royal Bank of Canada ratings.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Royal Bank of Canada ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Thursday it confirmed all ratings on the Royal Bank of Canada with stable trends.

DBRS said it confirmed Royal Bank and Royal Bank Mortgage Corp's deposits and senior debt at AA, Royal Bank's subordinated debt at AA (low), its cumulative preferred shares, series E, at Pfd-1, its non-cumulative preferred shares, series F, G, H, I, J, K, at Pfd-1 (low) and the short-term instruments for Royal Bank and Royal Bank Mortgage at R-1 (middle).
"Capital ratios as a whole compare well with the peer group," said the agency.
"Strong earnings were led by non-interest revenue sources, particularly security commissions and mutual funds helped by surging capital markets," it added.
